query: A client asks us to deliver a project earlier than agreed. How should I respond?

memories.context: Hey Elida, what brings you here? Come on in, I've got some fresh coffee brewing. We can catch up on what's been going on in your life. I've got a few minutes before I've got to get back to work on this project I'm working on.
memories.response: Thanks, Clinton. I just needed to ask you something. Can we talk about it here in the hallway? I don't want to disturb you while you're working. It's just a quick question, won't take long.

memories.context: Thank you, Akash. I'm glad you found my findings informative. I believe my research can greatly benefit our project. Would you like me to elaborate on the implications and potential applications of my discoveries?
memories.response: Jorden, I think we've got enough to work with. Let's focus on implementing what we have now. We can discuss further implications later. I don't want to overcomplicate things. Let's keep it simple and straightforward.

memories.context: Hey Daylen, I've been thinking about my project and I immediately thought of you! Your expertise in the field is exactly what I need to take it to the next level. Would you be willing to collaborate and share your knowledge with me?
memories.response: I'm not sure, Maxine. I'm not really comfortable with taking on new projects or sharing my expertise with others. I like to stick to what I know and do things my own way. I don't want to take any risks or step out of my comfort zone.

memories.context: Khiry, I just wanted to say that your work on this project has been outstanding! I'm really impressed with the attention to detail and creativity you brought to the table. You should be proud of yourself, you've done a fantastic job!
memories.response: Thanks, Annagrace. I just did what needed to be done. It was a team effort, really. I don't think it's a big deal. Let's just focus on the next task at hand and get it done.

memories.context: Kion, come on, don't be so dramatic. It was just a little white lie to get the project done. You would've only held us back with your indecisiveness. I did it for the greater good... and our grade.
memories.response: That's not a little white lie, that's a big fat lie! You didn't even ask me, you just took my name and used it without my permission. That's not right, and it's not fair. I don't care about the grade, I care about being treated with respect.
